name: Fiona WM
quote: I’ve seen many different people who do body work over the years and decided to see Selena who uses a different approach. I found her to be very knowledgeable, easy to work with, helpful and also fun, during our 10 sessions together. It was so interesting to learn more about how our bodies work and what I can do at home. Since seeing Selena I feel stronger, less achy and able to do more. As I approach my 70s I want to be as strong, flexible and fit as I can be and Selena has helped with that!

name: B Hope
quote: It was a pleasure to work with Selena on my path to healing and wholeness. I can see why Selena wants clientele who are engaged in their healing, because rolfing is truly a journey of self-discovery with guidance from a rolfer. This requires an active role of the client to be curious and aware of their body. Selena exhibits extensive knowledge and passion in this field of study. Her commitment to care and professionalism are top notch. I highly recommend doing as many of the full package as you can. Each session is very informative and helps integrate the various chains of connective tissue of the body into a dynamic whole. Thank you so much for your service, Selena!

name: G Chanut
quote: Selena helped me to balance my body and to walk properly again after a knee injury I had 3 years ago through her Rolfing knowledge, professionalism and careful manipulation. I feel more connected to my body and connected to my fascia tissue. I would totally recommend anybody to do Rolfing, injured or not! Thank you.

name: Elaine S.
quote: Selena is passionate about Rolfing, helping others to overcome their aches and pains and move with greater ease. She rebalances the body; but also through her observations and teachings, works with you to develop strategies to improve your health. I now move with greater ease and have made adjustments to ‘old habits’ which, unknowingly, created my challenges. She ‘gets’ what it’s like to live with physical challenges and my sense is this makes her an even more compassionate practitioner. She listens and takes time with you.

name: Michael T.
quote: After years of dealing with chronic shoulder tension from working at a desk, I finally found real relief through Rolfing with Selena. She has an incredible ability to identify where the root of the problem actually lies, which was not where I expected. After just a few sessions, I was sleeping better, standing taller, and feeling more at ease in my own skin. Her approach is thoughtful, skilled, and deeply caring.

name: Lauren D.
quote: I came to Selena after a difficult pregnancy left me with persistent lower back and hip pain. She not only helped me find relief but taught me so much about how my body had adapted and compensated during that time. I left each session feeling more connected and more confident in my body. Selena creates a space that feels safe, professional, and genuinely supportive. I cannot recommend her highly enough.

name: David R.
quote: I’d been living with sciatica for nearly two years before a friend suggested I try Rolfing. Selena was patient and thorough in her approach, never rushing through a session. By the fourth visit, I noticed I could sit through a full workday without that familiar burning pain. She gave me a completely new understanding of how my body compensates and what I can do about it.

name: Anya M.
quote: As a yoga teacher, I thought I knew my body well, but Selena showed me layers I had never considered. Her understanding of fascia and structural alignment is remarkable. After completing the ten series, I move differently, more efficiently, with less effort. My students have even commented on the change. Selena is a true practitioner of her craft.

name: James K.
quote: I was sceptical about Rolfing at first. I’d tried physiotherapy, massage, and chiropractic with limited results for my chronic neck and shoulder tension. Selena took the time to understand my whole body, not just the area that hurt. The relief I’ve experienced has been lasting, not just temporary. I finally feel like I’m inhabiting my body rather than fighting against it.

name: Barley C.
quote: Selena was great at getting me mobile again. I was destroyed. I advise going to see her.
